products.name: Chicken Karahi (1 KG)
products.description: Fresh chicken cooked in traditional desi wok with ripe tomatoes, green chillies, ginger juliennes and special Royal spices.

products.description: Juicy skewered minced chicken skewers char-grilled to perfection with mint, onion, and crushed spices.

products.description: Two pieces of smoky, tender grilled chicken served with mint raita and fresh salad.

products.name: Zinger Burger
products.description: Crispy spicy fried chicken fillet, fresh iceberg lettuce, special Royal garlic mayo on a toasted sesame seed bun.

products.name: Anda Burger
products.description: Classic desi street-style egg burger with spiced shami patty, fried egg, sliced onions, and tangy chutney.

products.name: Chicken Cold Sandwich
products.description: Chilled shredded chicken breast mixed with herb mayonnaise, cucumber slices in soft buttered crustless bread.

products.name: Chicken Mayo Sandwich
products.description: Hearty shredded chicken in creamy black-pepper mayonnaise toasted until lightly golden.

products.name: Chicken Hot Sandwich
products.description: Hot grilled sandwich packed with spiced diced chicken, melted cheese, and spicy chipotle sauce.

products.name: Chicken BBQ Hot Sandwich
products.description: Smoky barbecued pulled chicken tossed in sweet hickory glaze and melted cheese on grilled sourdough.

products.name: Chicken Biryani

products.name: Chicken Pulao
